## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm format:check`, `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test` pass
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] Docs and `CHANGELOG.md` updated if behavior changed
- [ ] No secrets, account IDs, internal hostnames or personal data in the diff
